versions.changelog:
Initial release of keeper-credentials: a secure skill for brokering scoped Keeper credentials between agents.

- Allows a user-facing agent to access only user-authorized Keeper vault folders via Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM).
- Supports one-time user bootstrap using a Keeper one-time token; persists config for silent future authentication.
- Credential delivery supports One-Time Share (secure link), Keeper Notation reference, and direct (inline) sharing.
- Promotes zero-knowledge, least-privilege by avoiding master password or whole-vault access.
- Detailed environment variable and install guidance for configuration and optional delivery modes.
